description: A mix task (outside mix ci) that runs every example not in the mix test subset: check-only by default (compile + agreement/correctness, no timing, so it runs on a loaded machine), and --bench to keep run_all.exs's scoreboard behaviour (verdict check, --snapshot). Exits non-zero on an incorrect or crashing example. Decide whether run_all.exs becomes a thin wrapper or goes. Include the fuzzy_search app's tests per the fuzzy_search ticket's decision. Consider adding the check-only run to the release set of defk-96f.2 (note it there). Document in examples/README.md.

comments.text: From defk-30c.4: include the fuzzy_search app's tests: (cd examples/fuzzy_search && mix deps.get && mix test), 7 tests, ~10 s. Needs /usr/share/dict/words.

title: Own task that runs every other example: mix defk.examples
